title: The Second Run Check
subtitle: Decide what the customer can take over
intro_text: Use this on one workflow before taking scheduled help out of an onboarding plan.

sections.title: Name the work
sections.instruction: Record the task, next real input, customer operator and recipient. Agree what the recipient needs from the result.

sections.title: Run it under normal conditions
sections.instruction: Use ordinary access and the support route agreed for future runs. Record who intervened, what they did and whether the recipient could use the result.

sections.title: Make the handoff decision
sections.instruction: Hand over the step, hand over part with named help, or keep scheduled help. Record the owner, support route and next run date.

example.heading: Example: a Friday escalation report
example.label: Fictional example.
rows: A new case type has no urgency value. The regular support route has yet to resolve it.
example.interpretation: Name the person who owns the mapping. Recheck the affected step before removing scheduled help.

prompt:
Workflow / next real input: [ ]
Customer operator / recipient / usable result: [ ]
What happened / help used / available next time: [ ]
Hand over / hand over part / keep scheduled help: [ ]
Owner / support route / next run date: [ ]
next_action: Book the second run while both teams are still involved.
methodology: Original worksheet informed by GitLab and GOV.UK practice guidance.
